[[File:Schneckengetriebe.png|thumbnail|An example '''bill of material''']]
A '''bill of material''' is a list of parts and subassemblies required to manufacture an [[end product]].

It often contains the following information:

* Part name
* Identification code
* Quantity required
* Parent-child relationship/hierarchy: if a part is part of a larger subassembly
